purpose: Historical research audit only. No strategy deployment, scanner, broker account reads or orders.
skill_basis: Recovered user strategy-backtesting requirements: freeze specification; chronological partitions; no OOS tuning; partition-local rolling indicators and no cross-boundary warm-up; independent implementation and inspectable evidence. Full installed skill package not available in this cloud session.
session: NYSE regular session; daily OHLC represents regular-session observations
partition_note: Original approximately 6/2/2-year boundaries retained for comparison; not a newly optimized date split.
entry: Flat AND WR(2)<-90 AND CCI(5)<-80 AND ADX_SMA(20)>=15
exit: Long AND (Close>previous daily High OR WR(2)>-30). No CCI exit.
adx: TR=max(H-L,abs(H-prevC),abs(L-prevC)); +DM=up when up>down and up>0 else0; -DM symmetric; +/-DI=100*SMA(DM,20)/SMA(TR,20); DX=100*abs(+DI--DI)/(+DI+-DI); ADX_SMA=SMA(DX,20). NOT Wilder smoothing.
primary_indicator_policy: Calculate independently inside each partition; no pre-partition inputs. Remain cash during warm-up and count those days in all-period performance. Zero denominators -> NaN -> no signal.
primary_portfolio_policy: Flat/cash start each partition; no incoming pending orders. Mark open positions at last close; do not invent liquidation fills. Never compound reset partitions and call it continuous.
execution: Signals after completed close; first following observed trading-session open; at most one position, no pyramiding; exit then evaluate new completed close.
sizing: 100% available simulated cash, fractional split-adjusted research units. QQQ sizing OFF. No account margin or borrowing; SOXL embedded fund leverage remains.
cost_model: Adverse fill: buy=open*(1+bps/10000), sell=open*(1-bps/10000). Combined spread/slippage/fees sensitivity, NOT measured execution cost. Separate commissions zero. Daily data cannot validate 90-second opening fills or capacity.
data: Fresh GET-only Tradier /v1/markets/history; do not substitute another source. Validate OHLC positivity/order, dates, duplicate/gaps and calendar; hash raw source. Independent Yahoo split-adjusted OHLC and optional dividend-adjusted sensitivity, never silently inner-join away missing dates.
adjustments: Use Tradier reported OHLC without additional transformation. Dividend adjustment not guaranteed by vendor; no explicit cash dividends credited. Yahoo auto_adjust=False split-adjusted OHLC comparison, and auto_adjust-equivalent OHLC as separate sensitivity. No claim of exact dividend-inclusive total return for Tradier.
settlement: Main idealized research engine assumes cash from sales reusable next session; do not claim cash-account settlement realism. Report this limitation explicitly.
diagnostics: legacy continuous one-year historical warm-up replication
full-window continuous with warm-up inside study only
five fixed one-year reused holdout folds with local warm-up
selection: No new parameter selection or retuning. All original parameters fixed. Neighborhood evaluated on IS only; Validation/OOS excluded from ranking.
oos_integrity: COMPROMISED/REUSED. Existing historical OOS has informed prior research. Future dates after the freeze are required for a fresh test.
decision_policy: Research-only regardless of attractive performance. Report validation and OOS metrics, implementation failures, data discrepancies, trade count/uncertainty; no production approval from a historical replay.
